scope: Continue only Mutation-Guided recovery on the 27 tasks with zero retained MG tests in v1. Do not launch Vanilla or Original generation, review, validation, or comparative analysis.

existing_artifacts.v2_vanilla_generated_before_amendment: Preserve as provenance only; exclude from the MG-only recovery outcomes and do not spend further calls on Vanilla.
existing_artifacts.v2_mutation_guided_on_mg_zero_tasks: Reuse successful calls and triage already recorded under the parent batch. Never repeat a generation slot that has a model-attempt artifact or captured response. A local pre-request harness failure with zero model calls may be corrected in a separate child output path and linked to its original slot.
existing_artifacts.v2_mutation_guided_on_nonzero_mg_task: The log_query call started before this amendment; preserve it as a pre-amendment artifact but exclude it from the MG recovery cohort and do not run its second slot. mocked_http receives no new MG call.

mg_generation.no_eligible_hint_policy: No MG call; keep the task in the cohort and report the unused opportunity.
mg_generation.retry_policy: No retry after a model attempt, completed response, empty response, or invalid response.

evaluation.candidate_review: Review only v2 Mutation-Guided candidates with the frozen method-blind C1 specification review; no Vanilla/Original candidates are reviewed.
evaluation.source_validation: Require C1 correctness, three stable source runs, and three target-mutant-kill runs for every retained MG candidate.
evaluation.later_checkpoint_scope: Evaluate only frozen MG composite suites (base tests + immutable v1 retained MG tests + retained v2 MG tests), across all 36 trajectories and 160 later-checkpoint pairs.
evaluation.reporting: Report MG-only retained-test coverage and confirmed regression events. Do not make Original-vs-MG or Vanilla-vs-MG comparative claims from this amendment.
